WITH all_weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT week_number FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020
)
SELECT c.week_number, c.week_date_formatted 
FROM all_weeks aw
JOIN cleaned_weekly_sales c ON aw.week_number = c.week_number
WHERE c.calendar_year = 2020
ORDER BY aw.week_number
